info.title: VaptScanner - catch security issues in .NET apps before they reach production.
info.description: Pre-production security scanner for .NET codebases: SAST rules, secret detection, config review, vulnerable NuGet audit and a safe DAST baseline scan.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Record current findings so a --fail-build gate only fails on NEW ones

options.name: --format
options.description: console, html, json, sarif or all   (default: console,html)

options.name: --out
options.description: Report folder                        (default: ./vapt-reports)

options.name: --fail-build
options.description:
Fail the build (exit code 1) if any finding >= severity
(severity defaults to High). Without it, vapt only reports

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Alias of --fail-build <severity>

options.name: --graph
options.description: Also write an HTML5 chart report to this file (or folder)

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Hide findings below this             (default: Low)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show explanation and fix for every finding in the console

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Skip paths, e.g. --exclude "**/Migrations/**" (repeatable)

options.name: --disable
options.description: Turn a rule off (repeatable)

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline file (default: .vapt-baseline.json in the scan root, if present)

options.name: --no-deps
options.description: Skip the NuGet vulnerability audit

options.name: --offline
options.description: Use the built-in advisory list instead of 'dotnet list package --vulnerable'

options.name: --authorized
options.description:
Confirms you own / are permitted to test the target
--header "Name: value"      Extra header, e.g. an auth token for a test account (repeatable)

options.name: --path
options.description: Extra path that must NOT be public (repeatable)

options.name: --max-requests
options.description: Request budget (default 120)    --delay <ms>  Delay between requests (default 100)
